name: cosmic-context-sync
description: Sync the modules planned in one topic's green cosmic-plan artifact (added or modified) back into the workspace-level project context, producing a refreshed green context; usable once the plan stage passes (workspace scope; pass the green context and topic plan as upstream).

moduleLevels.description: Depth of the module tree (1-3): the merged artifact's actual tree depth must equal it (rule context/module-depth); inherited from the upstream context receipt
